title: File:Sugarloaf National Recreation Trail (44125852685).jpg
claims: The image shows a hiker with a red backpack standing on the rocky Sugarloaf National Recreation Trail, with weathered pines, a fallen trunk and layered San Bernardino Mountains behind.

The Commons description from San Bernardino National Forest says the Sugarloaf National Recreation Trail leads to the highest point in Big Bear Valley; the 100M passes Sugarloaf twice, but this is a trail scene, not a race-day photograph, and has no bibs, chips or course markers.

The author is San Bernardino Nat'l Forest, with the Forest Service photo credited to Tania C. Parra; the file is public domain; the photograph was taken on 2018-09-28 at 14:23; the original is 2,400 x 1,600 pixels and 2,970,496 bytes.
The route page uses a 960 x 640 copy of 220,642 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits the author, licence and source.
